title: "Services & Expertise"
---

At **Rooted Data**, technical analytical rigor meets deep context awareness. Every project is tailored to ensure data serves both organizational goals and the broader public good.

## What We Do

### 1. Urban Analytics & Spatial Science
We combine geospatial analysis with data science to model urban systems, environmental patterns, and demographic shifts.
* Custom GIS workflows & spatial data pipelines
* Spatial statistics & predictive land-use modeling
* Interactive web maps and spatial dashboards

### 2. Data Governance & Responsible Sharing
Data is most valuable when shared safely and ethically. We help organizations build trust and infrastructure around sensitive datasets.
* Data governance framework development
* Secure inter-organizational data sharing agreements
* Ethical data risk assessments and privacy protection

### 3. Custom Software & Interactive Tools
When off-the-shelf software falls short, we design custom analytical tools and web interfaces tailored to your team's workflow.
* Web applications (R Shiny, Python Streamlit, React/Mapbox)
* Open-source data pipelines and R/Python packages
* Automated reporting systems

### 4. Community-Centered Engagement
Data should empower communities, not alienate them. We facilitate collaborative research and participatory data design.
* Participatory mapping & community co-design workshops
* Accessible data storytelling and public report design
* Community data literacy training
